injury_reports.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
injury_reports.summary: Gibbs rushed 20 times for 74 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jared Goff
injury_reports.summary: Goff completed 17 of 25 passes for 170 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while also rushing four times for five yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sam LaPorta
injury_reports.summary: The Lions have received trade calls on LaPorta leading up to Tuesday's deadline, but the team prefers to keep him with the hope of signing the tight end to a long-term deal, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Saylors
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
injury_reports.summary: St. Brown brought in eight of 10 targets for 86 yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Isaac TeSlaa
injury_reports.summary: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sione Vaki
injury_reports.summary: Vaki (ankle) is available for Sunday's game against Miami.

injury_reports.name: Jameson Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams brought in one of two targets for 31 yards and rushed once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brian Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Andre Cisco
injury_reports.summary: The Lions acquired Cisco from the Jets on Monday in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Roger McCreary
injury_reports.summary: McCreary (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Ennis Rakestraw Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rakestraw (ankle) does not have a game designation for Sunday's Week 8 tilt versus the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: D.J. Reed
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: DJ Wonnum
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jake Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 19-9 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Jack Campbell
injury_reports.summary: The Lions moved Campbell (neck) to injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Kerby Joseph
injury_reports.summary: Joseph (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Cade Mays
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Isiah Pacheco
injury_reports.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

injury_reports.name: Jimmy Rolder
injury_reports.summary: Rolder (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Chris Blair
injury_reports.summary: Blair went without a target while playing nine of the Falcons' 53 offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Zachariah Branch
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Beaux Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins (hip) is listed as active Sunday against the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson
injury_reports.summary: Dotson caught two of five targets for 95 yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Khalil Herbert
injury_reports.summary: The Falcons signed Herbert from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Drake London
injury_reports.summary: London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Penix completed 20 of 31 passes for 162 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 34-17 loss to Cincinnati. He added 50 rushing yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Pitts caught three of five targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Bijan Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson carried the ball 19 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and caught six of seven targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
injury_reports.summary: Zaccheaus (head) has returned to Sunday's matchup against Cincinnati in Madrid, Spain, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Yasir Abdullah
injury_reports.summary: Abdullah (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game versus the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Divine Deablo
injury_reports.summary: Deablo (forearm) is active for Sunday's game against the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: James Pearce Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Pearce (back) is listed as active Sunday versus the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Avieon Terrell
injury_reports.summary: Terrell (back/illness) is active for Sunday's game against Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Terrell Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Terrell (groin) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Samson Ebukam
injury_reports.summary: Ebukam (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons on Tuesday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Robinson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Anterio Thompson
injury_reports.summary: Thompson posted on social media this week that he was diagnosed with a genetic mutation on his spinal cord in early May and indicated that he was told he will "never play football again," Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Cameron Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (ankle), who remains on IR, has been ruled out for Sunday's clash against Cincinnati, Will McFadden of Atlanta's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught his only target for 11 yards Sunday in a 35-12 win against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson rushed six times for 34 yards and a touchdown and returned one kickoff for 29 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.summary: Kelce brought in four of six targets for 72 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday. He also rushed once for one yard.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Moore
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Andy Reid stated Moore (ankle) is considered "day-to-day," Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Nikko Remigio
injury_reports.summary: Remigio is officially active for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Rashee Rice
injury_reports.summary: Rice secured five of seven targets for 49 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker rushed 18 times for 102 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 41 yards and two more scores in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton registered 11 tackles (six solo) during the Chiefs' 20-3 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to Seattle with seven tackles (two solo).

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Drue Tranquill
injury_reports.summary: Tranquill finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 12 tackles (four solo).

injury_reports.name: Nohl Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 10 tackles (four solo) and one interception.

injury_reports.name: Peter Woods
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Butker missed his only field-goal attempt and made all five of his PATs during Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Omarr Norman-Lott
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs designated Norman-Lott (knee) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed

injury_reports.name: Kelvin Banks Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Banks (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: CJ Donaldson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Audric Estime
injury_reports.summary: Estime carried the ball 15 times for 72 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns. He also caught his only target for five yards.

injury_reports.name: Noah Fant
injury_reports.summary: Fant caught one pass for 12 yards on two targets in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win against Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Juwan Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught both of his targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Alvin Kamara
injury_reports.summary: Kamara rushed six times for 32 yards while catching three of four targets for 17 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime win against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Erik McCoy
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Chris Olave
injury_reports.summary: Olave caught seven of 12 targets for 98 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Cesar Ruiz
injury_reports.summary: Ruiz (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Shough
injury_reports.summary: Shough completed 21 of 35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_reports.summary: Tyson caught four of five targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Devaughn Vele
injury_reports.summary: Vele caught two passes for 17 yards on four targets in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Martin Emerson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Emerson is listed as active for Sunday's matchup against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Carl Granderson
injury_reports.summary: Granderson totaled four tackles, including 1.5 sacks, in Sunday's Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Justin Reid
injury_reports.summary: Reid (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Nathan Shepherd
injury_reports.summary: Shepherd (illness) practiced in full Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Smyth
injury_reports.summary: The Saints reverted Smyth to their practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injury_reports.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

items.name: Erik McCoy
items.impact: Reported Doubtful: C starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: CJ Donaldson
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at RB may be affected.

items.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at RB may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Corey Bullock
injury_reports.summary: Bullock (quadriceps) is active for Sunday's game versus Denver, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brady Christensen
injury_reports.summary: Christensen (hamstring), who is on IR, has been ruled out for Sunday's battle against the Broncos, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Coker
injury_reports.summary: Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Chuba Hubbard
injury_reports.summary: Hubbard carried the ball 16 times for 79 yards and caught four of five targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to Denver.

injury_reports.name: Damien Lewis
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tetairoa McMillan
injury_reports.summary: McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Tavion Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders recorded zero targets during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Torricelli Simpkins III
injury_reports.summary: Simpkins (ankle) is available for Sunday's game against Denver, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tommy Tremble
injury_reports.summary: Tremble caught four of six targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Darren Waller
injury_reports.summary: Waller caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Young
injury_reports.summary: Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Bobby Brown III
injury_reports.summary: Brown (hand) practiced fully Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Will Lee III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Bobby Okereke
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jaelan Phillips
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Zakee Wheatley
injury_reports.summary: Wheatley recorded seven total tackles (four solo) and an interception during Thursday night's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Marco Wilson
injury_reports.summary: The Panthers elevated Wilson from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Fitzgerald
injury_reports.summary: Fitzgerald missed his only field-goal attempt and went 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Jonathon Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Monday that the Panthers will spend the next two days discussing the status of Brooks (core), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaycee Horn
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Dave Canales plans to take "the next two days" to discuss Horn (quadriceps), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Mike Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Dave Canales stated the team plans to take "the next two days to discuss" Jackson (groin), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Legette
injury_reports.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Denzel Boston
injury_reports.summary: Boston caught six of seven targets for 98 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Michael Burton
injury_reports.summary: Burton (calf) has returned to Sunday's matchup against New Orleans, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: KC Concepcion
injury_reports.summary: Concepcion caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints. He added three yards on his only carry.

injury_reports.name: Malachi Corley
injury_reports.summary: Corley went untargeted while playing 13 of 70 snaps on offense Sunday in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

injury_reports.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Fannin caught both his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Dillon Gabriel
injury_reports.summary: Gabriel "will serve as the backup quarterback" Sunday against the Saints, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jerry Jeudy
injury_reports.summary: Jeudy caught two of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Quinshon Judkins
injury_reports.summary: Judkins carried the ball 15 times for 43 yards and caught his only target for two yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Sampson
injury_reports.summary: Sampson rushed eight times for 21 yards while catching three of six targets for 27 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Shedeur Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders completed 19 of 31 passes for 297 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints. He added 28 yards on 10 carries.

injury_reports.name: Tylan Wallace
injury_reports.summary: Wallace recorded a three-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Deshaun Watson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Maliek Collins
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Quincy Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

injury_reports.name: Andre Szmyt
injury_reports.summary: Szmyt went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to New Orleans.

items.name: Deshaun Watson
items.impact: Reported Questionable: QB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Maliek Collins
items.impact: Reported Questionable: DT starter availability could change this week's rotation.

injury_reports.name: Kayshon Boutte
injury_reports.summary: Boutte erupted for four catches (on five targets) for 125 yards and two touchdowns during Sunday's 44-22 road win against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Nico Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins corralled all four of his targets for 55 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 44-22 victory at the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Blake Fisher
injury_reports.summary: Fisher (thumb) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Harrison caught two of three targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Hutchinson
injury_reports.summary: Hutchinson caught three of five targets for 29 yards and a touchdown and  added a 28-yard kick return during Sunday's 44-22 win against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Woody Marks
injury_reports.summary: Marks turned 18 carries into 70 yards and hauled in one of four targets for four yards during Sunday's 44-22 road win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: David Montgomery
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Foster Moreau
injury_reports.summary: Moreau played 21 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in the Texans' 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylin Noel
injury_reports.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Dare Ogunbowale
injury_reports.summary: Ogunbowale didn't record an offensive touch or target in Sunday's 24-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Schultz
injury_reports.summary: Schultz caught two of four targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: C.J. Stroud
injury_reports.summary: Stroud completed 21 of 35 passes for 384 yards, five touchdowns and one interception and recorded two carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 44-22 win at the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Azeez Al-Shaair
injury_reports.summary: Al-Shaair (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Reed Blankenship
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Naquan Jones
injury_reports.summary: The Texans signed Jones on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Pitre
injury_reports.summary: Pitre (shoulder) was a full participant in Houston's practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: M.J. Stewart
injury_reports.summary: Stewart finished with 12 tackles (five solo), including 0.5 sacks, and a defensed pass in Sunday's overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Henry To'oTo'o
injury_reports.summary: To'oTo'o notched 10 tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, in Sunday's Week 7 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
injury_reports.summary: Fairbairn went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made all five of his PATs during Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Tank Dell
injury_reports.summary: Dell turned a team-high nine targets into four catches for 105 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 44-22 road victory against the Chargers

injury_reports.name: Aaron Banks
injury_reports.summary: Banks (knee) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Travis Glover
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Matthew Golden
injury_reports.summary: Golden brought in all 10 targets for 164 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: Kaleb Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson could serve as the Packers' lead option on the ground in Sunday's game against the Vikings with Josh Jacobs (finger) expected to miss multiple weeks and with the status of MarShawn Lloyd (knee) uncertain, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Tucker Kraft
injury_reports.summary: Kraft brought in one of three targets for one yard and rushed twice for eight yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: MarShawn Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jordan Love
injury_reports.summary: Love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed once for a 13-yard score in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday. He also ran in a two-point conversion.

injury_reports.name: Bo Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton exited Sunday's game against the Patriots and is being evaluated for a concussion.

injury_reports.name: Sean Rhyan
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Christian Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson secured seven of eight targets for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Whyle
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Savion Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught three of four targets for 25 yards and a touchdown while adding three rushes for 13 yards during Sunday's 45-27 win over the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Zaire Franklin
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Ty'Ron Hopper
injury_reports.summary: Hopper (chest) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie finished last Thursday's 27-19 win over Carolina with 10 tackles (three solo).

injury_reports.name: Keisean Nixon
injury_reports.summary: Nixon (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams recorded 10 total tackles (seven solo) during Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Devonte Wyatt
injury_reports.summary: Wyatt (ankle) is active for Thursday's game against the Panthers, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey Smack
injury_reports.summary: Smack went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made all four of his PATs during Sunday's 45-27 win against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Chris Brooks
injury_reports.summary: As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) may be ready to return from IR.

injury_reports.name: Micah Parsons
injury_reports.summary: Parsons (knee) officially was ruled out for Sunday's contest in New England.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Addison
injury_reports.summary: Addison secured two of three targets for 28 yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Odell Beckham Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Beckham is active for Monday's game against the Bills, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Brosmer
injury_reports.summary: Brosmer is set to back up Carson Wentz against the Bills on Monday, as Kyler Murray (hamstring) won't play, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: DeeJay Dallas
injury_reports.summary: Dallas was signed to the Vikings' active roster Wednesday, Craig Peters of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Darrisaw
injury_reports.summary: Darrisaw (shoulder) was a full practice participant Friday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Hockenson
injury_reports.summary: Hockenson recorded four catches for 33 yards on seven targets in a loss to Buffalo on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Justin Jefferson
injury_reports.summary: Jefferson brought in three of 11 targets for 58 yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Jauan Jennings
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones rushed five times for 16 yards and brought in his only target for five yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Mason
injury_reports.summary: Mason rushed six times for 35 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Murray
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Carson Wentz
injury_reports.summary: Wentz completed eight of 25 passes for 81 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed once for no gain in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Theo Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (quadriceps) is active for Monday's game against Buffalo, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Metellus
injury_reports.summary: Metellus recorded 13 tackles (six solo) and a defensed pass in a Week 8 defeat against Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Van Ginkel
injury_reports.summary: Van Ginkel (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's matchup against the Bills, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Eric Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson registered 11 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, in Sunday's loss to Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Demond Claiborne
injury_reports.summary: ir

injury_reports.name: Mo Alie-Cox
injury_reports.summary: Alie-Cox is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Dallas due to a groin injury.

injury_reports.name: Keenan Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught four of eight targets for 26 yards during Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Josh Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs caught three of six targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Dulin
injury_reports.summary: Dulin caught one of two targets for a 55-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys. He added three rushing yards on one attempt.

injury_reports.name: DJ Giddens
injury_reports.summary: Giddens did not appear in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Gould
injury_reports.summary: Gould (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's matchup versus Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Daniel Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones will remain with the Colts through Tuesday's trade deadline after the team informed him Saturday that he won't be moved, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer reports.

injury_reports.name: Seth McGowan
injury_reports.summary: McGowan rushed six times for 45 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for minus-3 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Drew Ogletree
injury_reports.summary: Ogletree (knee) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor rushed 13 times for 46 yards and brought in all five targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Travis
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Laquon Treadwell
injury_reports.summary: Treadwell caught one of two targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren brought in four of seven targets for 44 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Adetomiwa Adebawore
injury_reports.summary: Adebawore agreed Tuesday with the Colts on a two-year, $35 million contract extension, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Boettcher
injury_reports.summary: Boettcher (groin) was a full participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Carlies
injury_reports.summary: Carlies (neck) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Akeem Davis-Gaither
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: A.J. Haulcy
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Justin Walley
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Spencer Shrader
injury_reports.summary: Shrader went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Alec Pierce
injury_reports.summary: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

injury_reports.name: Kaytron Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught a 46-yard pass in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions. He rushed one time for minus-one yards.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas secured six of eight targets for 70 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Greg Dulcich
injury_reports.summary: Dulcich caught two of four targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Ollie Gordon II
injury_reports.summary: Gordon rushed 16 times for 55 yards and brought in his only target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Will Kacmarek
injury_reports.summary: Kacmarek is dealing with a quad injury and is questionable to return to Sunday's clash against Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Kadyn Proctor
injury_reports.summary: Proctor (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's Week 9 matchup versus Detroit, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Malik Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught two of three targets for 21 yards during Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Malik Willis
injury_reports.summary: Willis completed 13 of 25 passes for 128 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for seven yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Wright
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jordyn Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks recorded 11 tackles (six solo) in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Malik Herring
injury_reports.summary: Herring (neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Rodriguez
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez notched eight tackles (two solo) and forced a fumble in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Zach Sieler
injury_reports.summary: Sieler ruptured his biceps during Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions and will require season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Zane Gonzalez
injury_reports.summary: Gonzalez reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injury_reports.name: Darrell Baker Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Baker (undisclosed) is not ready to return to practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier compiled 17 carries for 46 yards and caught two of three targets for no yards during Sunday's 17-3 defeat at Seattle.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck is expected to start Sunday's contest against the Rams, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Devin Duvernay
injury_reports.summary: Duvernay caught both of his targets for 14 yards while also adding 75 yards as a kick returner and 12 punt-return yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime win against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Simi Fehoko
injury_reports.summary: Fehoko is listed as a starting receiver on the Cardinals' unofficial depth chart heading into Sunday's game at Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Hjalte Froholdt
injury_reports.summary: Froholdt is in league concussion protocol Monday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jon Gaines II
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Elijah Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins tallied two catches for 10 yards on four targets Sunday in a 33-30 overtime win over Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride recorded seven catches (on eight targets) for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 loss at Seattle.

injury_reports.name: Gardner Minshew II
injury_reports.summary: Per Adam Schefter of ESPN, Minshew (elbow) is reportedly seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he likely will require season-ending surgery to address a torn UCL.

injury_reports.name: Reggie Virgil
injury_reports.summary: Virgil failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Wallace III
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals signed Wallace from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jayden Williams
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Roy Lopez
injury_reports.summary: Lopez (toe) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's matchup with the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: Nolen (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland made his lone field-goal attempt during Arizona's loss versus the Seahawks on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Adams
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals activated Adams (ankle) off injured reserve Saturday, and he remains questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Bech
injury_reports.summary: Bech finished without a target or touch in Sunday's 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers caught seven of eight targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for two yards and lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Jeanty rushed six times for 25 yards while catching five of seven targets for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught two of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker caught four of eight targets for 55 yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington turned six carries into minus-three yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Cody White
injury_reports.summary: White was signed by the Raiders on Thursday, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey Zuhn III
injury_reports.summary: Zuhn (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Las Vegas' matchup versus the 49ers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Thomas Booker IV
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jeremy Chinn
injury_reports.summary: Chinn recorded 10 total tackles (four solo) and an interception during Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Nakobe Dean
injury_reports.summary: Dean recorded 12 total tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 38-33 victory against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Darien Porter
injury_reports.summary: Porter (groin) is active for Sunday's Week 9 battle against the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay converted his only field-goal attempt and both of his extra-point tries during Las Vegas' loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jake Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: Ryan Flournoy
injury_reports.summary: Flournoy caught two of three targets for 53 yards during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Goodson
injury_reports.summary: Goodson sustained ACL and MCL sprains in his knee during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, a source tells Todd Archer of ESPN.com.

injury_reports.name: CeeDee Lamb
injury_reports.summary: Lamb brought in 10 of 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Mingo
injury_reports.summary: Mingo (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: George Pickens
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Dak Prescott
injury_reports.summary: Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for one yard in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Luke Schoonmaker
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Drew Shelton
injury_reports.summary: Shelton (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brevyn Spann-Ford
injury_reports.summary: Spann-Ford caught two of three targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 27-23 win versus the Colts.

injury_reports.name: KaVontae Turpin
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Javonte Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 23 yards in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs (concussion) has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Donovan Ezeiruaku
injury_reports.summary: Ezeiruaku (ankle) is considered day-to-day, Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reports.

injury_reports.name: Marist Liufau
injury_reports.summary: Liufau (forearm) is active for Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: P.J. Locke
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: DeMarvion Overshown
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Joey Porter Jr.
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Dee Winters
injury_reports.summary: Winters (head) has returned to Sunday's Week 9 matchup against the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Aubrey
injury_reports.summary: Aubrey went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Bullard
injury_reports.summary: Bullard (calf) wasn't activated from injured reserve Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Malachi Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Dallas placed Lawrence (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.summary: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Kaelon Black
injury_reports.summary: Black rushed 11 times for 70 yards but wasn't targeted in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Mike Evans
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jordan James
injury_reports.summary: James rushed three times for 11 yards and returned two kickoffs for 31 yards Sunday in a 38-17 victory versus Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: George Kittle
injury_reports.summary: Kittle caught four of seven targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Christian McCaffrey
injury_reports.summary: McCaffrey rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Brock Purdy
injury_reports.summary: Purdy completed 17 of 25 passes for 232 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders. He added seven rushing attempts for 40 yards and a touchdown.

injury_reports.name: Demarcus Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, per Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area, and the 49ers removed his questionable designation for Sunday's game versus the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jordan Watkins
injury_reports.summary: Watkins caught all four of his targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Luke Gifford
injury_reports.summary: Gifford (groin) does not have a designation for Sunday's Week 9 tilt against the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Renardo Green
injury_reports.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Green (back) is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game at Dallas, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Gracen Halton
injury_reports.summary: Halton (ankle) is expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Deommodore Lenoir
injury_reports.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Lenoir (foot) is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game at Dallas, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Garret Wallow
injury_reports.summary: Wallow (hamstring) does not have a designation for Sunday's clash against Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Eddy Pineiro
injury_reports.summary: Pineiro made his lone field-goal attempt and all five of his extra-point tries during San Francisco's win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Nate Hobbs
injury_reports.summary: San Francisco didn't activate Hobbs (groin) from injured reserve Saturday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Kirk
injury_reports.summary: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: C.J. West
injury_reports.summary: The 49ers plan to open West's (undisclosed) practice window Wednesday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Chase Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown carried the ball nine times for 57 yards and caught all three of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Joe Burrow
injury_reports.summary: Burrow completed 24 of 29 passes for 271 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons. He added seven yards and a TD on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Marr Chase
injury_reports.summary: Chase caught 10 of 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Mike Gesicki
injury_reports.summary: Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 34-17 win versus Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Tee Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins caught five of six targets for 32 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-17 win over Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Dohnte Meyers
injury_reports.summary: Meyers failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Samaje Perine
injury_reports.summary: Perine rushed 11 times for 43 yards during Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Colbie Young
injury_reports.summary: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Barrett Carter
injury_reports.summary: Carter recorded nine tackles (three solo) and a pass defense during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Bryan Cook
injury_reports.summary: Cook recorded nine tackles (six solo), including 0.5 sacks, during the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Dugger
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Cedric Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (ankle) is listed as active Sunday against the Falcons in Madrid.

injury_reports.name: Demetrius Knight Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Knight totaled eight tackles (two solo) and an interception during the Bengals' win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Boye Mafe
injury_reports.summary: Mafe finished Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens with five tackles (three solo), including 1.5 sacks.

injury_reports.name: DJ Turner II
injury_reports.summary: Turner (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan McPherson
injury_reports.summary: McPherson went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts while making all four of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Erick All Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cashius Howell
injury_reports.summary: Howell (wrist) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Andrei Iosivas
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

injury_reports.name: Germie Bernard
injury_reports.summary: Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Rico Dowdle
injury_reports.summary: Dowdle rushed 15 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Pat Freiermuth
injury_reports.summary: Freiermuth caught both of his targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 27-6 win over the Browns. He added one rushing attempt for a one-yard touchdown.

injury_reports.name: DK Metcalf
injury_reports.summary: Metcalf brought in one of six targets for four yards in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Rodgers
injury_reports.summary: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Mason Rudolph
injury_reports.summary: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ben Skowronek
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brandon Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Steelers signed Smith off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

injury_reports.name: Darnell Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught three of five targets for 94 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win over the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Brandin Echols
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Patrick Queen
injury_reports.summary: Queen compiled 10 tackles (seven solo), including 1.0 sacks, during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Doneiko Slaughter
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: T.J. Watt
injury_reports.summary: Watt (calf) practiced fully Friday and doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Payton Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson totaled six tackles (three solo) and an interception during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chris Boswell
injury_reports.summary: Boswell made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: DeShon Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Sebastian Joseph-Day
injury_reports.summary: Joseph-Day (triceps) was placed on injured reserve by the Steelers on Thursday, Teresa Varley of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

injury_reports.name: Mark Andrews
injury_reports.summary: Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Rashod Bateman
injury_reports.summary: Bateman caught one of two targets for six yards in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday against the Chargers, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Cuevas
injury_reports.summary: Cuevas didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Joe Fagnano
injury_reports.summary: Fagnano completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while adding three rushes for 13 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Zay Flowers
injury_reports.summary: Flowers brought in three of six targets for six yards and rushed three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Derrick Henry
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens aren't expected to deal Henry before Tuesday's trade deadline, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Matt Hibner
injury_reports.summary: Hibner logged one reception for five yards on two targets in Thursday's loss to Baltimore.

injury_reports.name: Justice Hill
injury_reports.summary: Hill rushed nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injury_reports.summary: Lane did not draw a target Thursday in a loss to Jacksonville.

injury_reports.name: Devontez Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Hamilton
injury_reports.summary: Hamilton (hip) has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday night's contest against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Adisa Isaac
injury_reports.summary: Isaac (hamstring) is questionable to return to Thursday night's contest against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Roquan Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith finished with eight tackles (two solo) in Thursday's Week 9 loss to Jacksonville.

injury_reports.name: Malaki Starks
injury_reports.summary: Starks finished Baltimore's Week 9 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday with four tackles (three solo) and a forced fumble.

injury_reports.name: Nate Wiggins
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jake Moody
injury_reports.summary: The Falcons signed Moody off the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Huntley
injury_reports.summary: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Adam Randall
injury_reports.summary: Randall (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Thursday's game versus the Jaguars, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Derius Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis caught one of two targets for a 15-yard touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Omarion Hampton
injury_reports.summary: Hampton rushed 13 times for 60 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Tre' Harris
injury_reports.summary: Harris caught three of seven targets for six yards during Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Justin Herbert
injury_reports.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert "should be good to go" for Monday's game at Baltimore after imaging on the quarterback's injured left middle finger returned negative for a fracture, ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Johnston
injury_reports.summary: Johnston caught one of four targets for a 58-yard touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Kolar
injury_reports.summary: Kolar caught one of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
injury_reports.summary: Lambert-Smith did not garner a target during Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Ladd McConkey
injury_reports.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh noted Monday that McConkey is viewed as "day to day" with back spasms, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Keaton Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell rushed seven times for 33 yards and caught three of four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Brenen Thompson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: DJ Uiagalelei
injury_reports.summary: Uiagalelei completed two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown after replacing Justin Herbert (finger) in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, and head coach Jim Harbaugh said after the game that Herbert could have a fractured finger, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Justin Eboigbe
injury_reports.summary: Eboigbe is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Houston due to an ankle injury, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Hart
injury_reports.summary: Hart (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Daiyan Henley
injury_reports.summary: Henley (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Donte Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (hamstring) does not have a designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Deane Leonard
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Rodney Shelley
injury_reports.summary: Shelley (ankle) has no designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Isas Waxter
injury_reports.summary: Waxter (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Kendall Williamson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Cameron Dicker
